title: Wanted Suspect Leads Deputies on Chase in Michigan
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Paw Paw, Michigan — On November 20, 2024, at around 1 p.m., Deputies with the Van Buren County Sheriff’s Office initiated a traffic stop on a red Chevy pickup truck after observing a wanted suspect, who deputies identified as 60-year-old Jeffrey Henry, driving the vehicle. Deputies made contact with Henry who refused to exit the vehicle. Henry was a wanted suspect, he threatened to damage the deputy's vehicle and stated he was not going to exit the vehicle or comply with commands. The deputy observed Henry place the vehicle into four-wheel drive and into gear attempting to drive away. The deputy reached out and appeared to stab the back left tire with a knife. Henry fled leading deputies on a slow speed pursuit through the Village of Paw Paw. Henry attempted to get back to his residence during the pursuit and out of concern for officers' safety, Sheriff Daniel Abbott was able to get in front of Henry's vehicle bringing the pursuit to an end. Henry who was currently out on bond for separate charges was taken into custody and is currently lodged at the Van Buren County Jail on multiple charges including Flee and Elude and outstanding warrants.
